Container.Name: ChaptarrNG
Container.Overview: Built on .NET 10 LTS, ChaptarrNG manages audiobook and eBook libraries with format-aware automation and optional SeerrNG integration.
Container.Description: ChaptarrNG is Snapetech's maintained fork of Chaptarr, with format-scoped book requests and durable pending-import handling for SeerrNG. It is a standalone book manager and does not require SeerrNG. This template installs the ChaptarrNG GHCR image, stores app data under /config, and provides separate audiobook, ebook, and download paths. Set PUID and PGID to match your share ownership; the image defaults to 99:100.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: chaptarrng chaptarr books ebooks audiobooks readarr seerrng
Container.Changes: Initial ChaptarrNG Community Applications template for the SeerrNG-maintained fork.
Container.License: GNU General Public License v3.0 only
Container.Requires: Docker and persistent appdata storage. The default PUID and PGID are 99 and 100. Set the mapped appdata and media paths to locations accessible to that user and group.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the ChaptarrNG web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent ChaptarrNG database, settings, and logs.

Config.Name: Audiobooks
Config.Description: Audiobook library path. Configure this path as an audiobook root folder in ChaptarrNG.

Config.Name: eBooks
Config.Description: eBook library path. Configure this path as an ebook root folder in ChaptarrNG.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by the container. Match this to the owner of the mapped folders.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by the container. Match this to the group of the mapped folders.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Optional file-creation mask. Use 002 when a shared group needs write access.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, using a TZ database name.
